newsitem.title: ITALY: Police burst in on "summit" of Naples mobsters.
newsitem.headline: Police burst in on "summit" of Naples mobsters.

text.p: Italian police burst in on a dawn "summit" of suspected Naples mobsters on Thursday and arrested seven people on suspicion of organised crime offences.
A police spokesman in the town of Torre Annunziata, one of the most crime-ridden areas of the Naples region, said sniffer dogs and helicopters were used in the operation.
Police said the seven men under arrest were suspected leaders of the Gallo clan of the Camorra, the local equivalent of the Sicilian Mafia.
Two pistols and two radio receivers set to police frequencies were seized in the raid, police said.
